title: LP-Spec: Leveraging LPDDR PIM for Efficient LLM Mobile Speculative Inference with Architecture-Dataflow Co-Optimization
problem: Mobile LLM inference constrained by limited memory bandwidth and compute. Speculative inference increases compute-intensive GEMM operations creating new trade-offs for GEMV-accelerated PIM. Redundant draft tokens waste energy.
motivation: Enable efficient speculative inference on mobile devices through PIM architecture.
method: Architecture-dataflow co-design leveraging hybrid LPDDR5 performance-enhanced PIM: near-data memory controller enabling data reallocation between DRAM and PIM banks; hardware-aware draft token pruner minimizing energy consumption; dynamic workload scheduling maximizing parallel execution.
key_novelty: Architecture-dataflow co-design for speculative inference with draft token management on mobile PIM.
contributions: LPDDR5 performance-enhanced PIM architecture for mobile speculative inference
Hardware-aware draft token pruner reducing energy consumption
Dynamic workload scheduling and data reallocation between DRAM and PIM

metrics.speedup: 13.21x vs mobile solutions; 7.56x vs GEMV-accelerated PIM
metrics.other: 12.83x EDP reduction vs AttAcc PIM; 415.31x vs RTX 3090 GPU

limitations: Mobile-specific design; scalability to larger models or data center systems unclear.
